title: Character Candidate Prompt Input
description: Inputs for generating a single plain-text image prompt for 1-5 character candidate images.

reference_images.title: Reference images
reference_images.description: One or more reference images. Use them primarily for broad facial structure and overall hair length/style direction, subject to the selected lock options.

image_count.title: Number of images
image_count.description: How many candidate images the final prompt should request.

gender_presentation.title: Gender / presentation lock
gender_presentation.description: Gender or presentation that must remain consistent in every candidate.

ethnicity.title: Ethnicity lock
ethnicity.description: Ethnicity must remain visually consistent in every candidate. Example: Thai / Southeast Asian.

age_min.title: Minimum apparent age
age_min.description: Minimum apparent age for every generated candidate.

age_max.title: Maximum apparent age
age_max.description: Maximum apparent age for every generated candidate.

lock_clothing.title: Lock clothing from reference
lock_clothing.description: When true, keep the visible clothing design, color family, silhouette, and visible accessories consistent with the reference. When false, use neutral contemporary clothing and do not copy the reference outfit.

pose_mode.title: Pose behavior
pose_mode.description: Choose whether the pose should be invented naturally or broadly locked to the reference image.

camera_framing.title: Camera framing
camera_framing.description: Primary framing / shot distance for the generated character image.

custom_framing.title: Custom framing
custom_framing.description: Required only when camera_framing is custom. Example: seated 2/3 body from slightly above eye level.

hair_guidance.title: Hair guidance
hair_guidance.description: Optional extra direction for hair. By default the skill uses reference images only for approximate length, density, and broad style, not exact strand placement.
hair_guidance.default: Use the reference only for approximate hair length and broad natural hairstyle direction; do not copy exact fringe, swept strands, parting, or face-covering hair placement.

clothing_fallback.title: Clothing when not locked
clothing_fallback.description: Optional clothing direction used when lock_clothing is false.
clothing_fallback.default: simple contemporary neutral casual clothing appropriate to the character, understated and non-fashion-editorial

environment.title: Environment
environment.description: Optional environment or scene. Leave blank for a neutral realistic environment chosen automatically.

expression.title: Expression
expression.description: Optional expression direction. Leave blank for a subtle, believable, natural expression.

cinematic_intensity.title: Cinematic intensity
cinematic_intensity.description: Controls how strongly the prompt emphasizes film-still lighting, depth, and optical dimensionality.

depth_of_field.title: Depth of field
depth_of_field.description: Preferred depth-of-field treatment. Auto chooses a realistic value based on framing.

additional_instructions.title: Additional instructions
additional_instructions.description: Optional free-form requirements appended to the final prompt.
